title: Measurement run manifest (M3.3)
description: Every authoritative run is reproducible from this file alone. Emitted by load-driver.mjs at run start; the results CSV joins to it on run_id.

outstanding_job_policy.description: open_loop: submit on schedule regardless of in-flight. ui_faithful: at most one in flight per user (closed-loop; collisions dropped as deferred_by_policy).

authoritative.description: false = exploratory shakedown, excluded from the decision dataset (pre-MP-1).

cache_mix.description: declared 20/60/20 fractions for hit/near/cold; must sum to 1.

case_assignment_rule.description: how each scheduled event maps to (user, class-scenario) — e.g. round-robin users, cache_class drawn from cache_mix with the run seed.

users.description: cohort users participating, with their per-class scenario IDs.
